readings: For each media type, join its tracks to MediaType and calculate its bytes-per-millisecond rate as SUM(Track.Bytes) / SUM(Track.Milliseconds). SUM ignores NULL Bytes, while the denominator includes the duration of every joined track. Count every joined track. Exclude media types whose rate is undefined. Compute the simple average of the defined media-type rates, counting each media type once. Show only media types above that average, with the media type name, rate, track count, and rate minus the average. Do not round.

For each media type, join its tracks to MediaType and calculate its bytes-per-millisecond rate as the average of the individual Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds ratios for joined tracks with non-NULL Bytes and nonzero Milliseconds. Count every joined track, including tracks without a defined individual ratio. Exclude media types with no defined individual ratios. Compute the simple average of the defined media-type rates, counting each media type once. Show only media types above that average, with the media type name, rate, track count, and rate minus the average. Do not round.
queries:
WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name AS media_type_name,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
defined_rates AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM media_type_rates
    WHERE rate IS NOT NULL
),
average_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate
    FROM defined_rates
)
SELECT
    d.media_type_name,
    d.rate,
    d.track_count,
    d.rate - a.rate AS rate_minus_average
FROM defined_rates AS d
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE d.rate > a.rate

WITH media_type_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name AS media_type_name,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
    HAVING rate IS NOT NULL
),
average_rate AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT
    m.media_type_name,
    m.rate,
    m.track_count,
    m.rate - a.rate AS rate_above_average
FROM media_type_rates AS m
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a
WHERE m.rate > a.rate
